gappers.catalyst: Satellogic reports Q2 2026 earnings tomorrow (Aug 5) after market close, conference call at 4:30pm ET.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Satellogic (SATL) is set to report Q2 2026 results Wed Aug 5 after market close; the pre-earnings gap likely reflects positioning ahead of the print. Q1 2026 showed revenue of $6.11M (+80% YoY) but a widened net loss of $118.3M (+263% YoY), though management flagged the quarter as an inflection point with the company's first positive net operating cash contribution. The company also recently landed an $18M+ one-year defense-imagery contract and unveiled its next-gen Merlin constellation (first satellite launching Oct 2026).
gappers.why: Momentum/positioning buying ahead of the Aug 5 earnings call, amplified by recent contract wins (defense imagery deal) and constellation roadmap news (Merlin) building anticipation for a strong print.
gappers.impact: Pre-earnings gaps on thin-volume small caps (282K sh) are prone to violent reversal on the actual print in either direction - this reads as speculative positioning, not a confirmed trend. No clear sector-wide read-through; a single-name earnings-anticipation move.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM - earnings-binary event tomorrow (Aug 5 AMC) makes this headline/event-driven with no durable thesis until the print clears; expect a volatile resolution within 1-2 sessions either way.
gappers.opportunity_cost: 0/6 positions open, 0/3 weekly trades used - no existing holding would be displaced. But entering pre-earnings breaches the strategy's no-earnings-binary practice (same exclusion applied to BKSY/UMAC on 8/3); a 7-10% stop below a $4.26 entry gives ~$0.30-0.43 risk, needing a $0.85+ target for 2:1 R:R, only plausible on a clean beat that can't be known pre-report. Pass pending post-earnings confirmation.

gappers.catalyst: AST SpaceMobile shares up premarket ahead of the BlueBird 11-13 satellite launch and its August earnings report.
gappers.catalyst_detail: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) is preparing to launch BlueBird satellites 11, 12, and 13 via SpaceX Falcon 9 (targeting Aug 5), its second next-gen batch after BlueBird 8-10 launched in June. The new satellites carry the proprietary AST5000 ASIC, targeting 150+ Mbps per coverage cell (roughly 1.5x Block-1 performance, which already hit 98.9 Mbps to standard smartphones). Manufacturing has advanced through satellite 42; the company reports its H1 business update/trading statement Aug 10.
gappers.why: Anticipation buying ahead of a hard, dated launch catalyst (BlueBird 11-13) plus an accelerating constellation-deployment cadence, which the market reads as de-risking the path to commercial space-based cellular broadband.
gappers.impact: Volume (236K sh) is elevated but not extreme for ASTS's typical liquidity; the move is tied to a concrete, dated catalyst (launch window) rather than pure rumor, giving it more durability than a typical headline spike - though still vulnerable to a 'sell the news' fade post-launch. Read-through to satellite/space peers is plausible if the launch executes cleanly.
gappers.horizon: LONG_TERM - the BlueBird constellation buildout is a structural, multi-quarter thesis (accelerating satellite cadence, beta commercial service later this year) rather than a single headline; a multi-day/week swing hold is defensible IF it also clears the Confluence rule on a later /trade check.
gappers.opportunity_cost: 0/6 positions open, 0/3 weekly trades used this week - no existing holding displaced. As the higher-conviction of today's two gappers (structural catalyst vs SATL's earnings-binary risk), ASTS is the one worth validating via /trade's confluence check; a 7-10% stop below a $67.90 entry (~$4.75-6.79 risk) needs a $9.50-13.60+ target to clear 2:1 R:R, plausible on a clean launch with no material pullback. Research only, not a sized recommendation.
